warrants.quote: exchanged an aggregate of 20,440,000 shares of the Company’s common stock, beneficially owned by the Exchanging Holder for pre-funded warrants to purchase the same number of shares

Each pre-funded warrant issued in connection with the Securities Purchase Agreement has an exercise price of $0.0001 per share, is exercisable at any time until the pre-funded warrants are exercised in full and does not expire.
